limitations: Finite sampled images only; no continuous real-time playback or full-video review.
Audio track exists but was not listened to.
Button display does not establish input receipt or command acceptance; app/controller comparison is separate.
Encoded frame rate is not measured game frame rate.
No claim about human illusion perception, fear, comfort or actual iPhone performance.
Original video and extracted images stay under local Downloads/.expo and are not uploaded or committed.
